variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The variant set exhibits strong comprehensiveness, spanning reading block models via prompts like "What number do the blocks show?", interpreting number lines via "What number is marked on the number line?", and interacting with representations directly using "Move the dot to show 6795 on the number line."
